definitions.radius: A segment from a circle's center to a point on its circle.
definitions.diameter: A chord passing through the center, twice the radius in length.
definitions.chord: A segment joining two points on a circle.
definitions.arc: A connected portion of the circumference between two points.
definitions.central angle: An angle with its vertex at the circle center.
definitions.inscribed angle: An angle with its vertex on a circle and sides passing through two circle points.
definitions.tangent: A line meeting a circle at exactly one point.
definitions.secant: A line intersecting a circle at two points.
definitions.sector: A region bounded by two radii and their connecting arc.
definitions.segment: A circular segment is bounded by a chord and its arc; distinguish it from a line segment.
